other_conditions: The worker must be engaged in building or construction work.
The worker must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB).
The registered worker must have a minimum of one year of continuous membership with the Board.
The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹3,500 is provided to registered construction workers for purchasing a bicycle.
